note: Format of ai-eval/speech/recordings/recordings.json — live recordings of people (TASK-059). The folder recordings/ is not in git: these are people's voices. Files: WAV, 16-bit PCM, mono, any rate 8–48 kHz, at most 15 s (convert with any audio editor). expected — every acceptable spelling of what a person would type; article — the article that must come out exactly, or null. Run: pnpm --filter api operator ai:eval:speech --set recordings --models <a,b> --confirm-spend <usd>; results go to recordings/results/ (also out of git).
